set.body: Add locus-laws as cross-platform test support with exhaustive small finite models, bounded relation and parcellation enumeration, ScalaCheck supplements, and adapter differential helpers. Acceptance follows phase 4 and section 10 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md: tests are representation-independent, distinguish exact from floating-point laws, avoid generator explosion, and execute on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Locus 4: exhaustive laws and dense reference models
